item.title: [AFFECTED] [Reference Seed] Out-of-Band Update KB5045934 Issued for Windows 11 24H2 (Replaces KB5044284)
item.description:
KB: KB5045934 | Windows Version: Windows 11 24H2 | Severity: AFFECTED | Type: OOB_RELEASE (Local Reference Seed)
Microsoft released emergency Out-of-Band update KB5045934 (OS Build 26100.2036) to resolve OpenSSH service startup failure and Kerberos authentication errors in KB5044284.

item.title: [AFFECTED] KB5044284 Operational Health Changed: SAFE -> AFFECTED
item.description:
KB: KB5044284 | Windows Version: Windows 11 24H2 | Severity: AFFECTED | Type: STATUS_CHANGE (Local Reference Seed)
AFFECTED: Do not deploy KB5044284 without remediation. Microsoft issued Out-of-Band (OOB) emergency replacement update(s) KB5045934 to resolve critical regressions in KB5044284; Confirmed critical component failure: "OpenSSH (sshd) service fails to start and Kerberos authentication failure after installing KB5044284" (Confirmed).

item.title: [CAUTION] [Reference Seed] Known Issue Rollback (KIR) Group Policy Issued for KB5044285 (Windows 11 23H2)
item.description:
KB: KB5044285 | Windows Version: Windows 11 23H2 | Severity: CAUTION | Type: KIR_ISSUED (Local Reference Seed)
Enterprise-managed endpoints require Group Policy MSI 'KB5044285 241014_21401 Known Issue Rollback' and a system restart to mitigate USB IPP printer protocol issues.

item.title: [MONITOR] [Reference Seed] Active Zero-Day Exploitation Reported in MSRC: CVE-2024-43573 & CVE-2024-43572
item.description:
KB: KB5044273 | Windows Version: Windows 10 22H2 | Severity: MONITOR | Type: EXPLOITED_CVE (Local Reference Seed)
MSRC confirms active exploitation of CVE-2024-43573 (MSHTML Spoofing) and CVE-2024-43572 (MMC RCE). Addressed in October cumulative updates KB5044273, KB5044285, and OOB KB5045934.
